title: Open Arbor Verified Regenerative Consulting Arborist (RCA-Verified) Open Badges 3.0 Schema
description: AGPL v3 JSON Schema and JSON-LD template for a 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 / W3C Verifiable Credentials v2.0 OpenBadgeCredential attesting to the Verified Regenerative Consulting Arborist (RCA-Verified) designation under RCA-Spec v2.0. Encodes objective nature-first competency proofs (3 diagnostic report SHA-256 hashes, rhizosphere verification, STIM monitoring commitment) and optional legacy guild cross-walks without any payment flow.

@context.description: Required JSON-LD contexts for W3C Verifiable Credentials v2.0 and 1EdTech Open Badges v3.0 (unit: URI array).

id.description: Globally unique URI identifying this issued OpenBadgeCredential instance (unit: RFC 3986 URI).

type.description: W3C VC and 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 credential types (unit: type string array).

name.description: Canonical human-readable title of the credential (unit: string).

id.description: Decentralized Identifier (DID) or canonical URI of the Open Arbor Alliance issuer profile (unit: URI).

type.description: 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 issuer entity type (unit: enum array).

name.description: Public issuer name adhering to the two-word Open Arbor trademark boundary (unit: string).

url.description: Primary web host of the issuing organization (unit: URI).

validFrom.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the attestation becomes active (unit: UTC date-time).

validUntil.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when annual evidence re-verification is due (unit: UTC date-time).

id.description: DID or URI identifying the attested practitioner (unit: URI).

type.description: 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 subject type (unit: enum array).

practitioner_name.description: Full legal or professional name of the Regenerative Consulting Arborist (unit: string).

nature_first_competency_proof.description: Nature-first competency proof establishing practitioner diagnostic standing through verifiable field diagnostics, rhizosphere remediation, and longitudinal monitoring rather than closed guild membership.

diagnostic_report_hashes_sha256.description: Three SHA-256 cryptographic hashes of machine-validated RCA diagnostic assessment reports conforming to rca_assessment.schema.json (unit: array of 64-char hex strings).

root_collar_airspade_verified.description: Attests that non-destructive pneumatic root collar excavation was executed and documented (unit: boolean).

biological_amendment_verified.description: Attests that pre-charged biochar, fungal humates, or ramial woodchips were prescribed and applied (unit: boolean).

soil_biology_assessment_present.description: Attests that rhizosphere soil and microbiome baseline was captured (unit: boolean).

field_rhizosphere_verification.description: Field verification of rhizosphere decompaction, root-collar excavation, and biological inoculation (unit: object).

stim_monitoring_protocol_active.description: Active commitment to Sanctuary Tree Inventory and Monitoring (STIM) longitudinal tracking (unit: boolean).

year_1_recovery_milestone_target_date.description: Target date for Year-1 rhizosphere biology and tree vigor follow-up audit (unit: YYYY-MM-DD date).

longitudinal_monitoring_commitment.description: Longitudinal monitoring commitment anchoring continuous biological recovery (unit: object).

legacy_statutory_equivalencies.description: Optional cross-walk mapping of legacy guild credentials (ISA, ASCA, SAF) used solely for municipal permit statutory compliance.

credential_category.description: Legacy credential category for municipal permit administrative processing (unit: enum string).

credential_identifier.description: Legacy certificate or registration identifier (unit: string).

verification_url.description: Public directory URL where legacy credential standing can be verified (unit: URI).

id.description: Canonical URI of the RCA-Spec achievement definition (unit: URI).

type.description: 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 Achievement type (unit: enum array).

description.description: Summary of the diagnostic-first, holobiont-centered arboricultural practice standard (unit: string).

id.description: URI pointing to Section 5.2 of docs/13_RCA_PRACTICE_SPECIFICATION_v1.md (unit: URI).

narrative.description: States the nature-first requirement for (1) 3 machine-validated RCA diagnostic reports with SHA-256 hashes, (2) verified pneumatic rhizosphere remediation and biological amendment, and (3) longitudinal STIM monitoring commitment (unit: string).

governance_and_fee_benchmark.description: Non-paywalled benchmark metadata documenting Path C governance and the optional registry maintenance band.

specification_license.description: SPDX license identifier for docs/13_RCA_PRACTICE_SPECIFICATION_v1.md (unit: SPDX string).

schema_license.description: SPDX license identifier for the JSON schemas and validation code (unit: SPDX string).

optional_annual_registry_fee_band_min_us.description: Lower bound of benchmarked optional annual attestation registry maintenance fee (unit: US Dollars per year).

optional_annual_registry_fee_band_max_us.description: Upper bound of benchmarked optional annual attestation registry maintenance fee (unit: US Dollars per year).

benchmark_citations.description: Primary-source ecological credential maintenance benchmarks: SER CERP ($75/yr member maintenance) and NOFA AOLCP ($110/yr reaccreditation) (unit: citation string array).

payment_flow_encoded.description: Hard invariant confirming this schema contains zero payment gate or billing logic (unit: boolean).

evidence.description: Exactly 3 machine-validated RCA_v1 diagnostic assessment report artifacts conforming to schemas/rca_assessment.schema.json.

id.description: URI or content-addressed pointer to the anonymized RCA_v1 diagnostic report (unit: URI).

type.description: 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 Evidence type array (unit: enum array).

name.description: Human-readable title of the submitted diagnostic report (unit: string).

conforms_to_schema.description: Canonical schema URI against which the report JSON was validated (unit: URI).

schema_version.description: Validated RCA specification version (unit: version string).

report_sha256_hash.description: Hex-encoded 256-bit SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the canonical rca_assessment.schema.json payload (unit: 64-character hex string).

assessment_date.description: ISO 8601 date on which the field diagnostic was conducted (unit: YYYY-MM-DD date).

plus_code_global.description: Open Location Code (Plus Code) of the diagnosed tree (unit: Plus Code string).

inaturalist_taxon_id.description: iNaturalist taxon ID of the host tree evaluated in the report (unit: integer ID).

conflict_free_preservation_verified.description: Verifies the report prioritizes preservation and rhizosphere regeneration over unnecessary tree removal (unit: boolean).

proof.description: W3C Verifiable Credential cryptographic proof (DataIntegrityProof or Ed25519Signature2020).

type.description: W3C cryptographic proof suite identifier (unit: enum string).

cryptosuite.description: Data Integrity cryptosuite when type is DataIntegrityProof (unit: enum string).

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of signature generation (unit: UTC date-time).

verificationMethod.description: URI of the issuer public key used to verify the credential signature (unit: URI).

proofValue.description: Multibase-encoded or JWS cryptographic signature string (unit: encoded signature string).

achievement.name: Regenerative Consulting Arborist (RCA-Spec v2.0)
achievement.description: Attests that the practitioner diagnoses and manages woody perennials as nested holobionts across the five mandatory domains of RCA-Spec v2.0.

criteria.narrative: Requires nature-first proof of stewardship (3 machine-validated RCA diagnostic reports, field rhizosphere verification, longitudinal monitoring commitment) with optional legacy guild equivalencies.

NOFA Accredited Organic Land Care Professional AOLCP ($110/year reaccreditation fee)
